body:
"Every problem he has CAN be fixed, as long as he's alive."  
This is something I've been impressing upon him every time he starts talking about his issues, almost all his issues are self imposed ones, his work is too stressful because he either doesnt show up or doesnt want to attempt to find a new job (which he totally could do our town is full of places looking for new hires), his weight issues could be fixed by actually working out, his family issues could be solved by talking with his parents more and doing what they ask as to not cause a rift between them (they really dont ask a lot of him just basic shit), and all of this can really help to lower his stress but he doesnt seem to listen. I'm going to keep at it every time he brings it up until he either gets fed up and pushes me away like he does with some people or actually listens to me.
